verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that lets users create invoices, run payroll, generate reports, and ask natural-language questions like 'What's driving my profit?', which directly supports natural-language operation; there's also an official MCP server exposing 145 tools for programmatic/agentic access. However, this is vendor-claimed documentation only, with no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language reliability, and community feedback focuses on unrelated reliability/pricing complaints rather than confirming the AI chat's real-world performance. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Intuit Intelligence chat actually executing commands reliably, broader coverage of natural-language commands beyond the highlighted examples, and confirmation the MCP server enables full natural-language agent control rather than just API tool coverage.
